boundaries.name: Luxembourg commune boundaries (LAU2)
boundaries.source: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie
boundaries.notes: Stable file. Properties: COMMUNE, CANTON, DISTRICT, LAU2.

rents_apartments_by_commune.name: Advertised apartment rents per commune, rolling 12 months

rents_houses_by_commune.name: Advertised house rents per commune (sparse, 7 communes)
rents_houses_by_commune.notes: Same dataset as apartments. House rentals are too sparse for the choropleth, do not use as fallback.

sales_apartments_by_commune.name: Apartment sale prices per commune (existing + VEFA)
sales_apartments_by_commune.coverage_2025: 56 communes with at least one publishable price

logement_en_chiffres_pdf.name: Le Logement en Chiffres - quarterly synthesis report
logement_en_chiffres_pdf.notes: Contains zone-level aggregates (Canton de Luxembourg, Capellen-Mersch, Est, Nord, Esch-sur-Alzette). Not used in v1 but available for fallback aggregation.

name_normalization.comment: The data files use slightly different commune name conventions than the boundary file. Apply these mappings during the build.

api_pattern_for_latest_url.comment: To always fetch the latest quarterly file rather than hardcoding URLs, hit the dataset's API endpoint and pick the most recent resource by last_modified.
